title: 4. Structure that stays stable as it grows

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: A settled navigation should not rearrange itself; it grows consistently, and only real redesigns come up for review.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: The owner, 2026-10-27: "Once a repo has a settled navigation, it should not completely rearrange itself... evolve in a consistent manner automatically, with only significant redesigns coming up for PR" and "record the old structure, and then record what changed" (ac5974c6). "Semantic integrity is going to be directly related to navigability" (c8b12a7b). SP-117: a repository's structure stops fitting what it has recorded. No remedy answers it, and no record of a structure before and after a change exists yet.

sections.name: principle
sections.label: Principle
sections.content: Settled structure is stable; change is recorded; guidance follows the purpose. Owner's words only; no remedy.
